column1: # #1023 A/B shared oracle for a lexical leaf that matches nothing before a collection starts, measured with Java as
# returned-token.tsv (root SemanticPredicateScope(["t"])). EL is Lexing.LiteralParser("") (Rust JavaEmptyLiteral, UBNF ''
# in a token-stream or lexical-context grammar) and LX a LexicalTokenParser of z? (Rust Expr::Lexical): on success both
# add a token of the text they matched, here an empty consumed token, which starts the collection of their parent at
# the cursor as an empty collector's token does (the empty WordParser("") always fails and is not a shape here).
# hn and hx are the hosts of returned-token.tsv; Chain[hx,EL,vc] is not here, as Chain[hx,Opt[z],vc] is not there.
# Measured by unlaxer-dsl LexicalCollectorSourceTest, which builds these shapes as CollectorSourceTest does.
